deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary error rate spike >8% for model-infer-v2 in eu-west-1 (canary traffic 5%). https://ops/alerts/5786543210

sre-oncall: Taking this. Paging SRE/runtime. @eli @morgan please standby.

eli: I'm on it. Any confirmed customer errors?

jana: CS saw 2 enterprise customers report 500s + timeouts ~5m ago. Marking SEV3 while we assess.

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback attempted but failed: job "rollback-job-5786" returned error: "cache-lock timeout while acquiring model-kv". Logs: https://logs/rollbacks/5786

ops-bot: Tried flipping feature flag "canary_enable_model_v2" to false, toggle failed (timeout to flag-service, 502).

sre-oncall: Plan: 1) Drain canary traffic 2) Manual rollback to stable image sha-abc123 3) Run smoke tests and verify. @morgan please execute rollback and post outputs.

sre-oncall: Commands to run:
```
# rollback to previous stable
deployctl rollout rollback model-service --to sha-abc123 --region eu-west-1
# drain canary via proxy weight
proxyctl set-weight model-service.canary eu-west-1 0
# verify rollout
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/model-service-eu --timeout=10m
```

morgan: Running rollback now. Paste outputs below.

morgan: `deployctl` output:
```
Started rollback to sha-abc123
Created rollout job: rollout-5786
Rolling back replicasets...
Scale down new-replicaset -> 0
Scale up stable-replicaset (sha-abc123) -> 6
Rollout complete
```

morgan: Draining canary weight:
```
proxyctl set-weight model-service.canary eu-west-1 0
OK -> canary weight now 0 (was 5%)
```

ops-bot: Also toggled proxy traffic routing rules to stop canary headers being injected.

eli: Running smoke tests against eu-west-1 endpoints (3 requests):
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://eu1.api.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# responses: 200 0.12s, 200 0.11s, 200 0.15s
```

jana: CS confirms customers report normal behavior now. No error spikes visible on dashboards. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Good. Observing for 15m. ACTIONS: (1) postmortem to investigate flag-service timeout + rollback job cache-lock; (2) add fallback in auto-rollback when cache lock occurs.

customer-success: I've messaged affected accounts and scheduled a follow-up call. Will share notes in INC-5786543210 thread.

deploy-bot: Alert resolved — no active canary errors. Closing incident after monitoring window. Incident ref INC-2026-5786.

sre-oncall: Closing on my side. Follow-up ticket: INF-3421 (investigate flag-service latency & rollback cache-lock). Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
